content: Dota꞉ mo hande Iso o biki ma꞉nda꞉ Idomo la꞉la꞉ somena꞉ monduma꞉ monduma꞉ pieke wekiwandikina꞉ wekiwandikina꞉ bikie.
Isoma꞉ta꞉ Keinani wanda꞉weki miekeme. Ma꞉nda꞉ta꞉ Hidi hali Ilonona꞉ waneke Ada miekeme. Kutupa mo Hipi hali Sibionona꞉ eiyeke Anana꞉ waneke Oholibama make
Nebeiotona꞉ beliki Ba꞉sema꞉deta꞉ Isima꞉elona꞉ waneke make miekeme.
Titina꞉ wanda꞉ Adama꞉ta꞉ Elipa꞉se mendiaeyekeme. Ba꞉sema꞉dema꞉ta꞉ Leuelo mendiaeyekeme.
Kutupa Oholibamama꞉ta꞉ Dieusi make Dialamo make Kota make mendiaeyekeme. Do weki paeyaota꞉ mo Keinani kenke pa꞉ta꞉ hata꞉ Isona꞉ mendiaemeke weki tonue.

Kutupa Isoma꞉ta꞉ ipika꞉ wanda꞉weki make eiyeke tonu make waneke tonu make ipika꞉ da pa꞉ta꞉ haemeke wanda꞉hali paeyao make ipika꞉ ma꞉na꞉manu make mo Keinani kenke pa꞉ta꞉ hata꞉ mieke alemanu paeyao tonka꞉na꞉ mea hameke Dieikope mina꞉pa꞉lao mo kenke ma꞉nda꞉ pa꞉ta꞉ peekeme.
Ipiki mina꞉pa꞉laeyeke ekita꞉ mo Dieikope ipiliki haepeke kenketa꞉ ne doka꞉tiki yeke piekeme. Ipilika꞉ ma꞉na꞉ manuta꞉ wotu ta̱la̱o̱ handolo hata꞉ homeke pa꞉ta꞉ hapeke na yekeme.
Koto ekina꞉ Isota꞉ mo Idomona꞉ pote eli pa꞉ta꞉ pu hayekeme.
Dota꞉ mo hande Idomo wanda꞉halina꞉ apa꞉mei Isona꞉ monduma꞉ monduma꞉ pieke wekiwandikina꞉ wekiwandikie.

content.text: Isona꞉ weteke Adama꞉ta꞉ weki homeke Elipa꞉se mendiaeyekeme.
Kutupa weteke ma꞉nda꞉ Ba꞉sema꞉dema꞉ta꞉ weki homeke Leuelo mendiaeyekeme.
Isona꞉ eiyeke Elipa꞉sema꞉ta꞉ weki yunki hata꞉ mendiekeme. Ika꞉ biki manuta꞉ Temani make Oma make Sepo make Ka꞉tamo make Kena꞉se makee.
Kutupa Elipa꞉sena꞉ pa hameke e pokaeyeke wanda꞉ ma꞉nda꞉ Timinama꞉ta꞉ ipiki pa꞉ta꞉ weki homeke A꞉ma꞉leke mendiaeyekeme.
Kutupa Isona꞉ eiyeke Leueloma꞉ta꞉ weki tonkopu mendiekeme. Ika꞉ biki manuta꞉ Nahati make Sita make Siama make Misa makee. Ikita꞉ mo Ba꞉sema꞉dena꞉ wekina꞉ eiyeke tonue.
Isona꞉ weteke ma꞉nda꞉ Oholibamama꞉ta꞉ weki tepo mendiaeyekeme.
Ika꞉ biki manuta꞉ Dieusi make Dialamo make Kota makee.
Oholibamama꞉ta꞉ mo hande Sibionona꞉ eiyeke Anana꞉ wanekee.

content: Dota꞉ mo Iso pa꞉ta꞉ yama꞉ epemeke tapake you hali manue.

content.text: Mo Isona꞉ mupeke weki Elipa꞉seta꞉ do tapake manuna꞉ apa꞉meie.
Temani make Oma make Sepo make Kena꞉se make
Kota make Ka꞉tamo make A꞉ma꞉leke makee.
Do tapake manuta꞉ mo Isona꞉ weteke Ada pa꞉ta꞉ yama꞉ epemeke tapake manue.
Isona꞉ eiyeke Leuelo pa꞉ta꞉ yama꞉ epeeke tapaketa꞉ Nahati make Sita make Siama make Misa makee. Do tapake manuta꞉ Isona꞉ weteke Ba꞉sema꞉de mendiaeyeke ekie.
Dota꞉ mo hande Anana꞉ waneke Oholibamama꞉ Isona꞉ mendiaeyeke weki tonuna꞉ tapakemanue. Dieusi make Dialamo make Kota make mendiaeyekeme
Koto tapake paeyaota꞉ Iso pa꞉ta꞉ yama꞉ epemeke tapakemanue

content: Mo Idomo kenke kini pea haemeke tapakemanu ika꞉ apa꞉meita꞉ mo Ho hali Seiyana꞉ monduma꞉ monduma꞉ pieke wekiwandikina꞉ wekiwandikie. Koto tapake manuna꞉ apa꞉meina꞉ biki manuta꞉ doe.

content.text: Loutani make Soubalo make Sibiono make Ana make
Disiono make Esa make Disiana꞉ makee.
Loutanita꞉ mo Hoti pita꞉ Hemane yaapona꞉ apa꞉meie. Kutupa Loutanina꞉ belikita꞉ Timinae.
Soubalota꞉ mo Elipani make Manahati make Ebalo make Siepo make Onamo make paeyaona꞉ apa꞉meie.
Sibionota꞉ weki yaapo Aiyali pita꞉ Ana yaapo mendiekeme. Anata꞉ mo hande atekena꞉ donkimanu mo hande hapu hayeke alema꞉ handeteke hata꞉ mo titipu piki ikali opeekeeki handa꞉ wieke somee.
Anata꞉ mo Disionona꞉ atekee. Anama꞉ta꞉ wandiki ma꞉nda꞉ Oholibama make mondu wiekeme.
Disionota꞉ do tapake manuna꞉ apa꞉meie. Hemedani make Esibani make Itidani make Dietani makee.
Esata꞉ mo Bilihane make Sapani make Akane make koto tapake manuna꞉ apa꞉meie.
Disiana꞉ta꞉ mo Usu pita꞉ Atani tapake yaapona꞉ apa꞉meie.
Koto mo hande Idomo kenke pa꞉ta꞉ haemeke Ho tapake manuna꞉ bikie. Loutani make Soubalo make Sibiono make Ana make Disiono make Esa make Disiana꞉ makee.

content: Amba꞉ta꞉ mo Isulai wanda꞉halita꞉ kinimanu ma꞉nda꞉ma꞉ na handeteke haena꞉ta꞉ mo Idomo kenke pa꞉ta꞉ kini pieke kini manuna꞉ bikimanu doe.

content.text: Beona꞉ eiyeke Belata꞉ mo Idomona꞉ kini hali hayekeme. Ipika꞉ daonina꞉ bikita꞉ Dinihabae.
Bela homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ Sitana꞉ eiyeke Diobabema꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme. Ipika꞉ daonita꞉ Bositae.
Diobabe homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ Husamima꞉ ipika꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme. Ipikita꞉ mo Temani kenke pa꞉ta꞉ epeeke somee.

Husami homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ Bedadena꞉ eiyeke Hadadema꞉ ipika꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme. Ipika꞉ daonina꞉ bikita꞉ Apitie. Ipikana꞉ma꞉ta꞉ mo Moa꞉be kenke pa꞉ta꞉ mo Midiani tapake ame̱le̱ a꞉nda꞉ pea bepolayeke somee.
Hadade homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ mo Maseteka hali Samelama꞉ ipika꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme.
Kutupa Samela homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ mo ikali tea꞉na꞉ hayeke Teihobodi daoni pa꞉ta꞉ hayeke some Siauluma꞉ ipika꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme.
Siaulu homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ Akebona꞉ eiyeke Baele Hananema꞉ anketeke mea kini hali hayekeme.
Akebona꞉ eiyeke Baele Hanane homeeke dina꞉ta꞉ Hadadema꞉ anketeke miekeme. Ipika꞉ daonina꞉ bikita꞉ Paue. Ipika꞉ weteketa꞉ mo Mesahabena꞉ waneke Matededena꞉ waneke Mehetabelee.

content: Dota꞉ mo hande Iso pa꞉ta꞉ yama꞉ epeeke tapake manuna꞉ you haliwekina꞉ biki manue.

content.text: Timina make Alapa make Dietede make
Oholibama make Ela make Pinono make
Kena꞉se make Temani make Mibisa make
Makediele make Itame makee.

content: Koto you haliwekimanu haemeke kenke manuta꞉ ika꞉ bikimanu yalao haemeke tapake manue.
